result.description: Metalwork WA Pty Ltd   Position Overview   Metalwork WA Pty Ltd is seeking a skilled and motivated Full-time Metal Fabricator to join its fabrication team in Western Australia. The successful applicant will fabricate, assemble, install, maintain, modify, and repair structural steel and other fabricated metal products by interpreting engineering drawings, preparing metal materials, and carrying out welding and fabrication activities while maintaining high standards of quality, precision, and workplace safety.    Key Responsibilities    Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and work instructions.  Mark out, measure, cut, shape, and prepare metal sections, plates, pipes, and structural components.  Fabricate, assemble, and install structural steel, frames, platforms, handrails, brackets, truck bodies, and other fabricated metal products.  Fit, align, and join fabricated metal components using appropriate welding processes and fabrication techniques in accordance with engineering specifications.   Operate fabrication equipment including guillotines, press brakes, rollers, drills, saws, grinders, and other workshop machinery.  Inspect fabricated products to ensure dimensional accuracy and compliance with quality standards and engineering specifications.  Repair, modify, and maintain metal structures and fabricated products as required.  Maintain a safe, clean, and organised work environment while complying with workplace health and safety policies and procedures.  Maintain fabrication equipment and tools in a safe operating condition and comply with workplace health and safety procedures throughout all fabrication activities.     Skills and Experience   The successful applicant should possess:   A qualification relevant to metal fabrication, engineering fabrication, boilermaking, welding, or a closely related trade equivalent to AQF Certificate III including at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV (ANZSCO Skill Level 3).  Demonstrated ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, fabrication plans, and technical specifications.  Experience in fabricating, assembling, fitting, installing, modifying, and repairing structural steel and fabricated metal products.   Competency in welding and the safe operation of fabrication machinery and associated hand and power tools.  Strong knowledge of metalworking techniques, measuring equipment, quality control processes, and workplace health and safety requirements.  Good communication skills, attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.    What We Offer    Full-time permanent employment with an established Western Australian steel fabrication company.  Competitive remuneration commensurate with skills and experience.  Opportunity to work on diverse commercial, industrial, mining, and infrastructure fabrication projects.  A professional and safety-focused workplace with modern fabrication equipment.  Ongoing opportunities to develop technical skills and contribute to high-quality fabrication projects.  Supportive team environment with a commitment to quality workmanship and continuous improvement.    Application Process   Applicants must submit a resume and a cover letter outlining relevant experience and suitability for the role.  Metalwork WA Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse workforce.  About Company     METALWORK WA PTY LTD  is a Western Australian steel fabrication company specialising in truck body building, structural steel, and architectural steel fabrication. The company provides end-to-end fabrication services, including design, drafting, manufacturing, blasting, painting, and on-site installation for commercial, industrial, construction, and mining clients. Operating from a fully equipped workshop in Perth, Metalwork WA delivers custom metal fabrication solutions, site welding, and steel construction projects while maintaining a strong commitment to quality, workplace safety, and timely project delivery. The company has been actively operating in Australia since 2009 as a registered Australian proprietary company. result.description: Rumdel Construction Pty Ltd  The Construction Supervisor is responsible for the on-site planning, coordination, direction and control of road rehabilitation and pavement construction works, including asphalt milling, in-situ pavement stabilisation, spray sealing and asphalt paving. Operating within Rumdel Construction’s civil delivery teams, the role ensures works are completed safely, on program, within budget and in accordance with contract specifications, Australian Standards and relevant Transport for NSW (TfNSW) and local government requirements.   Benefits  Salary plus 12% super. Company provided vehicle or a vehicle allowance.   Task & responsibilities   Site Planning & Works Coordination   - Plan, organise, direct and coordinate day-to-day road rehabilitation operations across milling, stabilisation, spray seal and asphalt paving activities.   - Interpret engineering drawings, pavement designs and specifications to set out works and confirm levels, depths and tolerances.   - Coordinate labour, plant, materials and subcontractors to maintain continuous, efficient production and meet project milestones.   - Develop and communicate daily work plans, shift schedules and traffic staging arrangements.   Technical & Quality Management   - Supervise asphalt milling to specified depth, profile and cross-fall, ensuring surface preparation meets design requirements.   - Oversee in-situ stabilisation works, including binder spread rates, mixing depth, moisture conditioning and compaction.   - Manage spray sealing operations, including binder and aggregate application rates, temperatures and sequencing.   - Control asphalt paving and compaction to achieve specified thickness, density, joint quality and ride characteristics.   - Verify conformance against Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), TfNSW/MRTS specifications and approved hold and witness points.   Safety, Environment & Compliance   - Implement and enforce WHS requirements, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS) and safe systems of work on all activities.   - Manage worksite traffic in accordance with approved Traffic Guidance Schemes and Traffic Management Plans.  - Conduct pre-start meetings, toolbox talks, hazard identification and risk assessments.  - Ensure environmental controls for dust, noise, spillage and water management are maintained.   Plant, Resources & Productivity   - Direct the operation and allocation of milling machines, stabilisers, pavers, rollers, sprayers and support plant.  - Monitor production rates, material usage and wastage to optimise cost and program outcomes.  - Coordinate deliveries of asphalt, aggregates and binders, and liaise with suppliers and the asphalt plant.   Communication, Reporting & Stakeholder Relations   - Maintain accurate site records, daily diaries, quality records and as-built information.  - Liaise with the Project Manager, clients, superintendents, council representatives and the community.  - Provide on-the-job direction, training and mentoring to operators, labourers and apprentices.  - Report progress, productivity, incidents and non-conformances to project management.   Qualification & experience   Skills & Competencies   - Strong practical knowledge of road rehabilitation and pavement construction methods (milling, in-situ stabilisation, spray seal and asphalt paving).  - Ability to interpret civil engineering drawings, pavement designs and technical specifications, including TfNSW and MRTS standards.  - Sound understanding of WHS legislation, traffic management and environmental compliance in civil works.  - Proven ability to plan, coordinate and supervise labour, plant and subcontractors to program.  - Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving and decision-making skills.  - Commercial awareness of production rates, materials control and cost management.   Qualifications & Accreditation   - Relevant qualification in Civil Construction or Construction Management, or equivalent demonstrated experience (minimum five years) in civil road construction supervision.  - Demonstrated experience supervising asphalt, in-situ stabilisation and sprayed sealing works.  - General Construction Induction Card (White Card).  - Traffic management accreditation (for example, Prepare a Work Zone Traffic Management Plan) desirable.  - Current driver licence; relevant plant and high-risk work licences desirable.  About Company     At Rumdel Construction, we deliver world-class civil, mining, and road infrastructure solutions with the hands-on expertise forged over decades. Proudly rooted in South Africa and now building across Australia, we combine global standards with local insight.    From remote mining access roads to major arterial highways, our team brings technical excellence, environmental responsibility, and a results-driven mindset to every project.
